lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits. The primary constellation consists of three distinct horizontal rows of spots with roughly uniform spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, most notably in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal carina is visible running along the upper flank, displaying a high-contrast luminance gradient with clear highlights on the superior edge and deep shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, high-luminance spots are distributed across the surface of the first dorsal fin, with a higher density observed near the leading anterior edge of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of remoras (Echeneidae) is visible near the ventral midline and trailing the pectoral fin, appearing as elongated, low-luminance pixel clusters.
